verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is a fair question for a payments platform, but nothing in the evidence documents it for Stripe Terminal. Webhooks (stripe-terminal-docs-38) react to events rather than running on a schedule. Instant Payouts and Smart Disputes are one-off or adjacent automations, not user-defined recurring schedules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
